items.title: 17.13 RLC parallel circuit se AC (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: RLC parallel circuit mein resistor, inductor aur capacitor ek doosre ke parallel AC source se jure hote hain (Fig. 17.12(a)). Parallel jorne se total impedance aur current ki distribution (har branch mein kitna current) badal jati hai, is liye yeh series circuit se alag hai.
RLC parallel circuit ki key properties (khaas baatein)

1. Resonance aur impedance: parallel RLC circuit X_L = X_C par resonate karta hai. Us waqt impedance sab se zyada hoti hai aur circuit sirf resistor wale circuit jaisa behave (bartao) karta hai. Impedance:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is equation ko (17.27) number deti hai, lekin yeh number 17.12 mein P = VI cos θ ka hai. Yeh agli equation (17.28) honi chahiye; chapter mein (17.28) number kahin aur nahi.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Parallel mein resistances ki tarah reciprocals (ulte, 1/R aur 1/X) add hote hain. Resonance par 1/X_L − 1/X_C = 0 ho jata hai, is liye Z = R (sab se zyada).

2. Voltage aur current: parallel circuit mein har hisse par voltage ek hi hota hai, is liye voltage ko reference phasor lete hain. Resonance par source se aane wala current sab se kam hota hai, lekin branches (shaakhein) ke andar current bohat bara ho sakta hai; is liye ise current magnification (current barhana) ke liye use kar sakte hain. Frequency ke saath current ka badalna Fig. 17.12(b) mein hai. Resonance par branch currents I_L aur I_C dono resonance current Iᵣ se bare ho sakte hain.

blocks.alt: (a) AC source ke across parallel jure R, L aur C; line current I oopar ki taar mein aur neeche se wapas, aur branch currents IR, IL aur IC teen branches se neeche. (b) Current I aur frequency: smooth (hamwar) U-numa lakeer jis ka sab se nichla point, resonance current Ir, resonance frequency fr par hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Parallel circuit mein resonance par impedance sab se zyada hoti hai, is liye line current I sab se kam (Iᵣ) hota hai: graph neeche ki taraf jhukta hai. Series circuit mein ulat hai: wahan resonance par current sab se zyada hota hai (Fig. 17.11(d)).

3. Admittance: admittance (Y) impedance ka reciprocal (ulta, Y = 1/Z) hai; parallel circuits ko analyse karne (samajhne) mein kaam aata hai. Parallel RLC circuit ka total admittance har component ke admittance ka sum (jama) hai.

4. Frequency aur bandwidth: parallel RLC circuit mein impedance, admittance aur currents sab frequency par depend (munhasir) karte hain. Bandwidth frequencies ki woh range hai jis mein circuit theek (effectively) kaam karta hai. Resonance frequency:

Parallel RLC circuit tuning circuits, signal processing aur power systems mein bhi istemal hota hai. Induction cooktop (bijli ka chulha) mein bhi: parallel RLC circuit coil mein zyada frequency ka current banata hai, jo metal (dhaat) ke bartan mein current induce (paida) karta hai aur bartan garam ho jata hai (Fig. 17.12(c), kitab mein tasveer).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Electrocardiogram (ECG) dil ki bimariyon ki diagnosis (pehchan) mein kaam aata hai: dil dharakte waqt jo chhoti chhoti electric waves (bijli ki lehrein) banti hain, unhein record kar ke CRO (screen) par dekha jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab box mein naam 'ECTR OCARDIO GRAM' chhapti hai; sahi naam ELECTROCARDIOGRAM (ECG) hai.

5. Quality factor (Q): Q batata hai ke resonance ki peak (choti) kitni sharp (tez) hai, aur circuit mein store energy, dissipate (kharch) hone wali energy ke comparison mein kitni hai. Parallel RLC circuit mein Q resistance R ke directly proportional (seedha mutabiq) hai: Q = R√(C/L).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke parallel RLC circuit mein Q resistance ke inversely proportional (ulta mutabiq) hai. Sahi: parallel circuit mein Q = R√(C/L), yani R barhe to Q barhta hai. Inverse relation (ulta taluq) series circuit ka hai, jahan Q = (1/R)√(L/C).
6. Power factor: parallel RLC circuit ka power factor frequency aur X_L aur X_C ki values par depend karta hai. Resonance par power factor 1 (unity) hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Resonance par series aur parallel RLC circuits mein source ke current mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Series circuit mein impedance sab se kam (Z = R), is liye current sab se zyada; parallel circuit mein impedance sab se zyada, is liye source (line) current sab se kam.

items: Parallel RLC: har branch par ek hi voltage; Z = 1/√((1/R)² + (1/X_L − 1/X_C)²).
Resonance (X_L = X_C): Z sab se zyada, source current sab se kam; fᵣ = 1/(2π√LC).
Admittance Y = 1/Z; uses (istemal): tuning, induction cooktop.
